Hi again,

Although I didn't fix the job browser problem, I did fix the logistic regression :

Turns out the X wasn't in a matrix form so all I had to do was put it in a matrix and it ran perfectly :)

Here the modified source code :

logistic.regression = 
  function(input, iterations, dims, alpha) {
    
    lr.map =

function(., dta) {
        Y = dta[,1] 
        X = as.matrix(dta[,-1])
        Z = X %*% t(plane)
        keyval(1, Y * X * g(-Y * as.numeric(Z)))

}
    
    lr.reduce =
      function(k, Z) 
        keyval(k, t(as.matrix(apply(Z,2,sum))))
    
    
    plane = t( rep(0, dims) )
    
    g = function(z) 1/( 1 + exp(-z) )
    
    for ( i in 1:iterations ) {
      gradient = values( from.dfs( mapreduce( input, input.format=make.input.format("csv",sep=";"), map = lr.map, reduce = lr.reduce, combine = T ) ) )
      plane = plane + alpha * gradient 
    }
    plane
  }

Thanks again for the help !
